featured.title: Wave Forcing: Towards Speed-of-Light Streaming Video Generation
featured.tldr: Wave Forcing lets several video chunks denoise at once on different GPUs, with earlier chunks serving as cleaner context for later ones, reaching about 135 end-to-end frames per second on eight H200 GPUs.

featured.title: WorldBridge: Bridging Video and Action for Task Generalization in World Action Models
featured.tldr: In a video-plus-action world model, videos of new tasks without action labels lift out-of-distribution success on RoboTwin 2.0 from 25% to 56%, and one labeled demonstration per task lifts it to 71%.

featured.title: Hierarchical World Models with Implicit Dynamics
featured.tldr: ID-WM plans long tasks by using diffusion noise as an abstract action that picks reachable subgoals, while a second model converts each hop into precise actions.

featured.title: An ODE-based Sampler for Discrete Diffusion Models
featured.tldr: Exponential residual flows give discrete diffusion language models an analogue of the probability-flow ODE: after one random draw, sampling is deterministic yet provably keeps the right distributions, enabling consistency distillation.

featured.title: Algebraic World Model: From Exploration to Proofs
featured.tldr: An agent that learns an unfamiliar game's rules, compresses them into an explicit algebraic model and formalizes it in Lean can prove levels unwinnable; it also clears all 183 public ARC-AGI-3 levels.

featured.title: L3G-World: Real-Time Infinite World Generation with Latent 3D Gaussian Memory
featured.tldr: L3G-World gives a video world model a compact 3D memory of Gaussians that store video-latent features, keeping explored scenes consistent on revisits while generating in real time at about 9 frames per second.

featured.title: Rollback: Experience Backtracking in World Models for Policy Improvement
featured.tldr: Rollback rewinds a learned video world model to key moments of real robot attempts, tries alternatives there, and trains on what worked, beating the average human player at ball tossing and curling within 8 hours.

featured.title: RynnVLA-Latent: Scaling Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models with 3D-Grounded Latent Actions
featured.tldr: Alibaba's RynnVLA-Latent pretrains a robot policy on 30,100 hours of human, robot and simulation video using 3D-grounded latent actions, then adapts it to real robots, matching or edging out leading policies.

featured.title: DiscoDemo: Discovering Efficient and Diverse Robot Demonstrations for Imitation Learning
featured.tldr: Training a simulated RL "demonstrator" to find many different successful solutions, rather than one, doubles the real-robot success of a vision-language-action policy trained on its demos.

featured.title: Learning the 4D World through Point Trajectory Forecasting
featured.tldr: Training a multi-view video world model to also forecast where tracked 3D points will move yields more faithful futures than a video-only twin and higher robot success rates.

featured.title: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
featured.tldr: A benchmark that recombines familiar states and actions into new goals shows world models fail even when every ingredient was seen in training, and contact-rich tasks fail even with true state as input.

featured.title: Looking Ahead: Modeling Future Evolution in Autoregressive Video Generation
featured.tldr: Future Chunk Prediction adds a training-only auxiliary task to autoregressive video diffusion, predicting chunks several steps ahead, which improves physical plausibility without changing inference.
